name: Cave Worm Axons
text: The giant axons harvested from cave worms stretch alongside your own nervous system and carry signals from your brain that maintain your momentum. When you begin your turn with the Slowed condition or a Stunned condition that has a value, you become Quickened until the end of your next turn. You can use the action to Step or Stride. You can instead Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim if you have the appropriate Speed.
